fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3312010: checked with ecs::EntityWorld::IsEntityAlive, looked up for an existing actor control and written to esv::timeline::BackgroundActorRequestOneFrameComponent+0 / used as the entity that receives esv::ServerTimelineActorDataComponent.

fields.name: Type
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3312010 compares the byte with 0x20: such an actor only gets a esv::timeline::BackgroundActorRequestOneFrameComponent, any other goes through actor registration (bg3.exe+0x330CEC0).

fields.name: Peers
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330C7C0 (~esv::TimelineSystem::CreateTimeline) fills it right after creation (bg3.exe+0x3314CA0) with the 4-byte array copy bg3.exe+0x2FBE710 (memmove count*4) from esv::EoCServer(+0xA8)+0x6F8; bg3.exe+0x3312010 copies it into esv::ServerTimelineActorDataComponent+0x10 of every actor; bg3.exe+0x33026C0 (~ConfirmTimelineCreation) empties it (size = 0) when the timeout runs out. The Toolkit signatures around it use net::PeerID (TypeWrap<int>), hence int32. Live: 1 element, capacity 1 (single player).

fields.name: Actors
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330C7C0 copies the key set with bg3.exe+0xEB6890 from the creation parameters (+0x88) and allocates count*16 bytes for the values, copied 16 bytes each. bg3.exe+0x3308CB0 walks keys (+0x30, stride 0x10) and values (+0x40, stride 0x10) in parallel, hands each pair to bg3.exe+0x3312010 and erases the handled ones; bg3.exe+0x3308E10 finishes the creation when the key count (+0x3C) is 0. The key is the actor Guid stored into esv::ServerTimelineActorDataComponent.Actor. Live: 5 buckets, 2 keys, 2 values.

fields.name: Timeout
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x330C7C0 writes 0x41200000 (10.0); bg3.exe+0x33026C0 tests it against 0 and on expiry clears Peers and Actors and resets the flag at +0x55. Live: 10.0.

fields.name: ActorsHandled
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x33026C0 sets it to 1 when bg3.exe+0x3308CB0 (per-actor handling, ~HandleTimelineCreationActors) returns true and skips that call while it is set. Created 0; live 0.

fields.name: PeerConfirmed
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x3307970 (~esv::TimelineSystem::ConfirmPeerCreation) ORs the bool at +0x14 of the create handshake into it (the bool of ProcessProtocolCreateHandshake(PeerID, Guid, bool)); bg3.exe+0x33026C0 handles the actors only when it is set and clears it on timeout; bg3.exe+0x3308E10 takes the failure path (bg3.exe+0x33090C0) when it is 0 at the end. Created 0; live 0.

open_questions: Field names are descriptive, none comes from the Toolkit.
Whether Peers holds the peers still to confirm or all involved peers (it is only copied and cleared in the code read).
TimelineCreationActor.Type: only the value 0x20 was seen in code (background actor); it is probably the actor type enum of eoc::timeline::Actor.
The values part of the map is pointer + 32-bit count without capacity (live: 2 at +0x48, 0 at +0x4C), as in Script Extender's HashMap.
